conclusion.reason: Four officially named base release lineages can fill the author, critic and two-panel roles, but the fourth identity gpt-5.5 has no local emitted-model receipt, and no hardened contained full roster campaign has run. lineagePolicy.rule: Use the official primary-provider exact model identifier and its declared release family, then require the runtime trace to emit that exact identifier. Provider equality alone does not collapse distinct documented base release lineages; marketing labels or a local availability cache alone do not establish an executed lineage.
lineagePolicy.trustedSealBoundary: The root-owned collector, dispatch journal, separate contained contexts and withheld artifact access are the prospective seal authority. No external signing service or weights attestation is required by this threat model.
lineagePolicy.prohibitedInference: Do not count requested model strings, marketing names, local cache entries or caller-supplied baseModelLineage fields without an exact emitted-model receipt bound to the campaign terminal.
